fields.label: Extension name
fields.help: One of pg_available_extensions on the server (66 on the 2025.2.2.2 demo, among them vector, pg_cron, pg_partman, documentdb and hll).

fields.label: Schema
fields.help: WITH SCHEMA at install; afterwards SET SCHEMA, for relocatable extensions only.

fields.label: Version
fields.help: Empty: the default version. Afterwards ALTER EXTENSION UPDATE TO a version this one has an update path to (the record lists them). YugabyteDB spells its own versions, for example 1.8-yb-1.0.

fields.label: Install dependencies
fields.help: CASCADE: also install extensions this one requires.

gaps.concept: Choosing from the server's available extensions and versions
gaps.reason: The form offers text; a server-fed choice list needs a catalog-driven options source
Drop removes the extension alone; dependent objects make it fail

notes: YugabyteDB extensions; providers/yugabytedb/extensions.py, replacing the provider's create-only form. The record reads version, schema, relocatable, comment and update_versions (pg_extension_update_paths from the installed version). Round trip verified live on YugabyteDB 2025.2.2.2 by tools/tests/test_ui_descriptor_roundtrip_yugabytedb.py (2026-10-30).
